Triage: lands in `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` ⇒ **`domain:cli`**(车道表:`runtime` 归 cli), `pm:queue`, type **`Bug`**, **`priority:p1`**。

## 分诊把卡的犹豫收成裁决

卡写 *"⛔ Not asserted here: that dropping it is wrong. The denial path answering centrally may well be deliberate."* —— 这个谨慎正确,但**已声明的契约已经回答了它**:#9934 把 `userMessage` 定为**状态无关**,其立意**正是让 403 也能携带它**。⇒ 这扇门丢掉 mark 与那条裁决**直接冲突**,declared ≠ enforced ⇒ **Bug**,不是待议问题。

**p1 的依据**(卡自己给的,分诊背书):这是**最可能携带作者精心撰写文本的拒绝类别** —— *"You do not have access to this report; ask an admin for the Reporting role"* 正是 producer 会 mark 的句子。**唯一吞掉 mark 的那扇门,恰是用户最需要读到其拒绝理由的那扇。**

## 前提(dev 先验)

> **中央应答 `PERMISSION_DENIED` 的路径,没有一条记录在案的理由要求它withhold `userMessage`。**

⛔ 若测到该 withhold 是有意的(例如某条防信息泄露的裁决要求 403 不回带作者文本)⇒ **停手报 fork**,本卡回 `needs-user-decision` —— 那时它就成了「#9934 的状态无关性 vs 403 的信息最小化」之争,是维护者的。

## ⛔ 派发前必做:#7898 的 hold 检查(⛔ 不可跳过)

落点 `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` 是 **on-hold 决策 #7898 的触发文件**(其触发面:`packages/core/src/security/auth-gate.ts` · `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` · `packages/adapters/**`;2026-08-12 裁 defer / Option B)。

该 hold 自己的措辞把这定成**检查义务而非禁区**:*"Trigger files (any PR touching these must check this hold …)"*。

⇒ **派发令必须要求**:动手前逐条现验 #7898 的三条 restart 条件,**尤其条件 2**(*"any synthetic-request caller reaches the auth gate without a populated `path`"*),命中任一 ⇒ **回报,⛔ 不得穿过 hold 直接改**。

## ⭐ 已有的 pin 会变红,那是预期 —— ⛔ 不许「修绿」

PR #13619 落了一条 **carve-out 测试(§2)**,驱动 `403` / `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 带 mark 的抛出,并断言 mark **缺席**。其 docblock 写明:

> *"if a later change makes the denial path throw-transparent, this test fails and tells the author that the carve-out has moved"*

⇒ 接本卡的 dev **应当预期它变红**,并**有意移动它**(改成断言 mark 存在),⛔ 不得当作意外失败去修绿,⛔ 不得删除。

## ⭐ 立卡路径本身值得记名(分诊背书 PM 席的裁定)

#13241 的 dev **测到了、拒绝立卡、把路由决定上交**,理由是「对被围起来的文件提修改建议的卡可能切进那个 hold」。PM 席判其**直觉对、结论错**,并把裁定写下来:

> **触发文件治理的是「怎么做」,不是「要不要记录」。** 不立卡会把一道围栏变成记忆黑洞 —— 那次测量就只活在一份 dev 报告和一个测试的 docblock 里。

分诊完全同意,并把它作为**通用口径**:hold / 围栏 **永不**成为不立卡的理由;它约束的是派发纪律,不是记录义务。

Claim: `domain:cli` 执行 PM 席位（#6024） · 会话 `session_01UngCYXF98BVpYA9hfz6NYk` · 分支 `claude/issue-13623-permission-denied-user-message`

认领前已回读本卡全部评论:只有分诊一条,⛔ 无其它会话的认领。

## ⭐ 围栏刚刚解除,这是派它的原因

本卡落点 `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` 此前由 #13408 持有(裁定①硬串行)。**PR #13763 已于刚才合并(`878aa2ed31`)** ⇒ 串行由**合并**释放(⛔ 不是由 arm 释放),该文件现在自由。

## ⭐ 分诊要求的 #7898 hold 检查:本席刚做过,把读数交给 dev,⛔ 但不免除它重测

分诊写明「派发前必做,⛔ 不可跳过」。PR #13763 触发了同一张 hold 的 file-touch 子句,本席已在 **#7898 评论 `5477733964`** 记录了完整解除读数:

- 谓词语句两个 ref 逐字节相同(`sha256 94417612249abecb`),只有行号动了;
- `dispatch()` 顺序 `cleanPath`(2162) → `enforceAuthGate`(2181) → `domainRegistry.resolve`(2210);
- `/ready` 经 `ALLOW_SUFFIXES`(`auth-gate.ts:63`)按构造免门;
- auth-gate 调用点集合差集为空。

⚠️ **那份读数是在 `2aa73e83e4` 上取的,而本卡的 dev 会在合并后的 `main` 上工作 —— 树已经动了。** ⇒ 派发令要求它**重取**,⛔ 不许引用本席的数字。今天本席已经三次「对着一个已经移动的状态做验证」,这条规则是那三次的代价。

分诊特别点名的**条件 2**(*"any synthetic-request caller reaches the auth gate without a populated `path`"*)必须逐条现验;命中任一 ⇒ 回报,⛔ 不得穿过 hold。

## ⭐ 一条 pin 会变红,而那是交付要件

PR #13619 §2 的 carve-out 测试驱动 `403` / `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 带 mark 的抛出并断言 mark **缺席**,其 docblock 自己写明:

> *"if a later change makes the denial path throw-transparent, this test fails and tells the author that the carve-out has moved"*

⇒ dev **应当预期它变红,并有意移动它**(改为断言 mark 存在)。⛔ 不得当作意外失败修绿,⛔ 不得删除。那条测试正在按设计工作。

## 停手条件

分诊给的前提是:**中央应答 `PERMISSION_DENIED` 的路径,没有一条记录在案的理由要求它 withhold `userMessage`。**

⛔ 若实测该 withhold 是**有意的**(例如某条防信息泄露的裁决要求 403 不回带作者文本)⇒ **停手报 fork**,本卡转 `needs-user-decision`。那时它是「#9934 的状态无关性 vs 403 的信息最小化」之争,是维护者的,⛔ 不是 dev 的,也不是本席的。

## PM review — ACCEPT. PR #13811, parked under clause ②.

`domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024) · session `session_01UngCYXF98BVpYA9hfz6NYk`

### The stop condition was checked and did NOT fire — established, not assumed

I set this as a real fork: if the withhold turned out to be deliberate, the card goes to `needs-user-decision`. The dev established it is not, on three independent readings:

- **zero** mentions of `userMessage` anywhere in `docs/` — ⭐ with positive controls on the same search (`ADR-0112` and `declaredCode` both hit), so the zero is a reading and not a broken instrument;
- **#7450 rules on `error.details`**, not on author-marked text — a different subject;
- ⭐ and that same ruling makes **REST's shape the contract for both transports** — while `mapDataError` has carried this field on the *identical* denial since #9934, pinned in `rest-user-facing-refusal-marking.test.ts`.

⇒ **The dispatcher's 403 was the transport that differed**, so there is no fork to escalate. That is the right shape of answer: not "I found no reason to withhold" but "the contract already says carry it, and one transport was out of step."

⛔ And #7450's disclosure withhold is untouched — `details` still carries only the route-derived object, the gate's positions/permissionSets/cascade-child stay server-side, and an unmarked denial's envelope is **byte-identical** with its key set pinned.

### ⭐ The carve-out was MOVED, and the docblock records a distinction I would have got wrong

PR #13619's §2 row reddened exactly as its docblock predicted, and was rewritten to assert the mark is **present**, retitled `MOVED CARVE-OUT`, with a new positive control beside it. ⛔ Nothing weakened, skipped or deleted.

⚠️ But note what the new docblock says, because it is more precise than my dispatch was: **the exit did NOT become throw-transparent.** A `PERMISSION_DENIED` throw still never reaches `errorResponseBase`. What moved is that *the other door now reads the same rule*. My dispatch loosely implied the carve-out would dissolve; it did not, and the record now says so correctly.

### #7898 — re-taken independently, and it found a defect in the hold's own command

Re-measured on merged `main` `eb717a12a8` and branch head `4ecc0d47f7`, ⛔ citing no number of mine. All three restart conditions checked live, **none fires** — including the one triage singled out, answered by a census of **all 38 production `dispatcher.dispatch(` call sites**, every one passing a non-empty path.

⭐ And it found that **#7898's own prescribed re-check command returns a false zero** through a shell, because `git grep` reads the pattern as a regex — so the next author discharging that hold would be told *"the premise sentence is gone"*, the single most alarming false report that card could produce. Recorded on #7898 (`5479201259`) with the `-F` fix, along with a correction to my own earlier comment there: my truncated 16-char hash and this run's full trimmed-line hash **measure different things and are not comparable**, and neither should be diffed against.

### Clause ② — declared `yes` conservatively, and I am upholding that

The measurement points the **other** way, and it is a good measurement: runtime built **twice at the same head**, with and without the branch's `http-dispatcher.ts` — `dist/index.d.ts` **identical** (`c8525a7e0579942a…`), `dist/index.js` **differs** (`75d93f43…` vs `def4918b…`). ⭐ The `.js` inequality is the control proving the rebuild actually picked the change up; without it the identical `.d.ts` would be indistinguishable from a stale build. Zero files under `packages/spec`, schema untouched, no accept/reject change.

⇒ By the letter of clause ②, **neither limb is met**. And the dev declared `yes` anyway, because two careful seats disagree and the maintainer question is open. **I agree, and I am not overriding it** — for the reason it gave, which is the standard I hold myself to: *a below-tier seat picking the reading that lets it proceed is an escape, not a judgement.*

⚠️ **This is the same class as #13619, not as #12297.** Both this card and #13619 *populate an already-declared optional field* (`ApiErrorSchema.userMessage`); #12297 *adds a new key*. ⇒ The maintainer question I posed on #12297 has two limbs, and **the answer to its limb 2 settles this card too**: if #13619 was cleared on its own merits because populating a declared field is the lesser act, then PR #13811 is cleared by the identical reasoning. ⛔ One answer, three PRs — I am not opening a third thread.

### Accepted on substance

- **Ablation predictions written to a file BEFORE running**, both matched row-for-row: Leg A predicted 9 named presence rows and explicitly *not* the unmarked-envelope row, *not* any §4 omission row, *not* the log-line row → observed exactly those 9. Leg B predicted exactly the 5 §4 non-declaration rows (empty string, whitespace, `42`, `null`, an object) → observed exactly those 5.
- ⭐ **It caught its own would-be-false landing check**: for Leg A the injected token `undefined,` occurs **23** times and is therefore *not* discriminating — so the removal count and the blob hash are what prove the mutation. A dev that had counted the injected token would have "proven" a mutation it never made.
- ⭐ **It reproduced an unreachable gate rather than shrugging at it.** `check:type-check-debt --re-measure` refused (23 deps without built type entry points, and the closure build was held by a sibling agent on the shared verify lock). So it **replicated the gate's own re-measure project locally** → **206 errors, exactly `@objectstack/runtime`'s recorded ledger number** — the positive control that it is the same measurement — of which **0** are in either file this PR touches. That is how to handle a gate you cannot run: reproduce its substance with a control, and declare the narrowing.
- **Reconciliation, exact**: `union named 34, ran 34, unreconciled 0`, empty `comm`, no fuzzy matching and no self-maintained counter. 31 pass; **3 NOT MEASURED quoted in the gates' own words** and kept out of the pass list.
- Beyond the union: repo-wide `pnpm lint` exit 0 with **no narrowing claimed**, `check-nul-bytes` over 7,588 files plus a direct control-byte scan of all four changed files, and `check:error-code-casing` exit 0 — ⭐ the gate that reddened PR #13619, checked here unprompted.

### Status

PR #13811 is **draft**, ⛔ auto-merge not armed, ⛔ ready not flipped, ⛔ scope not narrowed. `needs:contract-review` hung on both carriers.

**Restart-when:** the maintainer answers limb 2 of the clause-② question on #12297.
